unlisted_practices: Create comprehensive, privacy-preserving datasets containing complete image sequences and longitudinal studies for training video-text models on 3D medical images and medical videos.
Develop benchmarks and downstream tasks that evaluate models' capability to integrate multi-sequence information, synergistic information, and medical world models.
Pretrain video-text models on existing video-text datasets and then fine-tune them on 3D medical data or medical videos.
Apply institution-level de-identification and mild distortion of surface areas to protect patient privacy in 3D medical imaging datasets.
Provide protocol data, metadata, and clinical information as inputs to video-text models to support accurate interpretation of 3D medical images and medical videos.
Apply preprocessing such as windowing or normalization to DICOM images before input to video models pretrained on 8-bit color data.
Align multimodal and longitudinal studies precisely with their corresponding reports for model training.
Decompose clinical reports into dense captions targeting specific body regions or organs and localize them with segmentation models for training targets.
Prioritize inference speed in video-text models used for real-time assistance during endoscopy and surgery.
Create reasoning datasets from radiologic and endoscopic reports to train reasoning models for medical image interpretation.

screen.reason: This is a perspective article proposing the adaptation of video-text generative AI models to 3D medical imaging and videos, discussing applications and challenges rather than presenting an empirical study.
